I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team to confirm that the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Dock 23.

I didn't save it anywhere else, and I didn't add it to gbrain. Pree's post in #central-team is the record. If I wrote it into the brain, it could show up for people who aren't in that channel. Pree said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything more.
